name: workstar
description: Reactive web framework with SSR, signals, and experimental React-style TSX compatibility without React at runtime.
author: Workstar Lab <hello@workstarlab.com>

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace workstar-router && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:packages: npm run build && npm run build --workspace workstar-app && npm run build --workspace workstar-compiler
scripts.verify:router: npm run check --workspace workstar-router && npm run test --workspace workstar-router && npm run build --workspace workstar-router
scripts.verify:app: npm run check --workspace workstar-app && npm run test --workspace workstar-app && npm run build --workspace workstar-app
scripts.verify:compiler: npm run check --workspace workstar-compiler && npm run test --workspace workstar-compiler && npm run build --workspace workstar-compiler
scripts.verify:compat: npm run build --workspace workstar-compiler && node scripts/verify-compat-hmr.js
scripts.verify:vscode: npm ci --prefix editors/vscode && npm test --prefix editors/vscode && npm run package --prefix editors/vscode
scripts.verify:worker: npm run check --workspace workstar-worker-starter && node scripts/verify-worker.js
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check:release && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run size && npm run verify:hydration && npm run verify:router && npm run verify:app && npm run verify:compiler && npm run verify:compat && npm run verify:compat:esbuild && npm run verify:compat:runtime-vite && npm run verify:vscode && npm run verify:starter && npm run verify:worker && npm run verify:node && npm run verify:packaged-starter && npm pack --dry-run
